general.title: General
general.description: Configure your Tavvit instance. These settings affect all users.

instanceName.label: Instance Name
instanceName.description: The name shown on the login page and to federated instances.

discovery.label: Space discovery
discovery.description: How far spaces on this instance can be found.

invite.label: Invite only
invite.description: Spaces here are listed nowhere. Invite links still work.

local.label: Local space discovery
local.description: Spaces appear in Explore for people on this instance and on instances connected to it.

global.label: Allow global listing
global.description: Approved spaces can then also be listed in the global Tavvit directory, when their owners opt in from their Discovery settings.

discovery.unconfigured: This instance is not configured to reach a directory, so nothing here can be listed globally.

directory.listingHint: Turning this on lists no space by itself. A space must have an approved listing and switch on "{{setting}}" in its Discovery settings.
directory.registrationClosed: New accounts from other instances are closed, so listed spaces will show as closed to new accounts.
directory.disclosure: For each listed space this makes public: its name, description, icon, banner, member count and this instance's address. People browsing the directory load the icon and banner from this instance.

reasons.unreachable: the directory could not reach this instance
reasons.status: this instance answered with an error
reasons.invalid: this instance served an invalid document
reasons.origin-mismatch: this instance reports a different address than the one it was reached at
reasons.origin: the directory refused this instance's address; it must be an https domain with no port (set DOMAIN or PUBLIC_ORIGIN)
reasons.network: this instance could not reach the directory
reasons.timeout: the directory did not answer in time

browse.toggleDescription: People here see spaces from other instances in Outer Space. Their browsers load those spaces' icons and banners from the instances that own them.
browse.unavailable: This instance is not configured to reach a directory, so there is nothing to show.

gif.label: GIF Search
gif.description: Enable GIF search powered by Klipy. Get a free API key from the Klipy developer portal.
gif.placeholderSaved: Key saved — enter new key to replace

accent.label: Accent colour
accent.description: The colour of buttons and highlights for everyone on this server.
accent.tooLight: This colour is too light: white text on a button would be hard to read.
accent.tooDark: This colour is too dark: it would disappear into the dark panels.

emoji.title: Emoji
emoji.label: Everyone can add emoji
emoji.description: Off: only administrators add to the library. Everyone can use what is in it.

registration.title: Registration
registration.description: Control who can create accounts on this instance. Public registration covers local sign-ups; federated registration covers users from peered instances creating an account here.

public.label: Public Registration
public.toggleDescription: Anyone can create a local account from the registration page. When off, only invite links can create new local accounts.

federated.label: Federated Registration
federated.toggleDescription: Users from other instances can create a federated account here via their Connections settings. Existing federated accounts can always log in regardless of this setting.

invites.label: Invite Links
invites.noMatch: No invites match the current filter.

form.name: Name
form.maxUsesInteger: Max uses must be a positive integer

createModal.title: Create invite link
createModal.description: Generate a shareable link that lets people register on this instance. You'll set how many times it can be used and when it expires.
createModal.createdManual: Link created. Copy manually from the row.

editModal.title: Edit "{{name}}"
editModal.description: Adjust the limits on this invite link. The URL stays the same — anyone who already has it can still redeem under the new constraints.
editModal.maxUsesBelowUsed: Max uses cannot be less than current uses ({{used}})

reinstateModal.title: Reinstate "{{name}}"
reinstateModal.descriptionRevoked: This invite was revoked. Reinstating generates a new link with a different URL — the old URL stays inactive.
reinstateModal.descriptionLapsed: This invite has lapsed. Reinstating reactivates the same URL — anyone who saved it will be able to use it again.
reinstateModal.newLinkWarning: A new link will be generated. Anyone who had the old URL will not be able to use it.
reinstateModal.maxUsesMin: Max uses must be at least {{min}} (current uses: {{used}})
reinstateModal.doneCopied: Reinstated with new link. Copied to clipboard.
reinstateModal.doneManual: Reinstated with new link. Copy manually from the row.
reinstateModal.doneSameLink: Reinstated. The same link is active again.

redemptions.title: Redemptions for "{{name}}"
redemptions.description: Users who registered using this invite link, in the order they signed up.
redemptions.revokedNotice: This invite was revoked. The redemptions below represent users who registered before revocation.
redemptions.revokedNoticeDated: This invite was revoked {{date}}. The redemptions below represent users who registered before revocation.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke "{{name}}"?
revokeDialog.description:
The link stops working immediately. Anyone who has the URL can no longer use it.

If you change your mind later, Reinstate issues a fresh link under this entry — the original URL stays inactive.

deleteDialog.title: Delete "{{name}}" permanently?
deleteDialog.description: This cannot be undone. Redemption history for this link will also be removed. If you only want to stop the link from working, use Revoke instead — that preserves the redemption record.

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Monitor disk usage and clean up orphaned files left behind by deleted content or replaced avatars/banners.

accountLimits.label: Limits per account
accountLimits.description: So that no single account can fill the disk. Admins have no limit, 0 means none, and what an account already keeps stays when you lower a limit. A single account can get its own limit on its page.

cleanup.label: Cleanup
cleanup.nothingFound: No orphaned files, stale uploads, or dangling records found.

stale.label: Stale Uploads
stale.description: Abandoned tus upload sessions in .tus/ (paused/crashed without DELETE). Auto-expire runs every 24 hours; this lets you sweep proactively.

streaming.title: Streaming
streaming.description: These limits apply to all users on this instance. Users can pick values within these bounds.

bandwidth.label: Bandwidth
bandwidth.description: Minimum and maximum bitrate bounds, and the step size for the quality slider.

customBitrate.label: Allow Custom Bitrate
customBitrate.description: Let users set their own bitrate instead of using the matrix defaults

quality.label: Quality
quality.description: Available resolution and frame rate options for screen sharing.

highEndWarning.title: High-performance settings enabled.
highEndWarning.description: Streaming above 1080p or 60 fps requires significant client-side CPU/GPU encoding power and can saturate server bandwidth, especially when streams are routed through TURN. High-end configurations (e.g., 4K at 120 fps) can require up to 45 Mbps per active stream. Ensure your infrastructure can handle this load before enabling these options for all users.

matrix.label: Bitrate Matrix
matrix.description: Default bitrates per resolution and frame rate. Edit individual cells or scale all values at once.
matrix.scaleHint: Drag to scale all bitrates. Fine-tune individual cells below.

capWarning.title: Matrix values exceed global cap.
capWarning.description: Some bitrate values exceed your maximum of {{max}}. Streams at those combos will be quality-degraded to your cap.

users.title: Users
users.description: View and manage user accounts on this instance.

actions.federatedNoReset: Federated users authenticate via home instance
actions.selfDelete: Use account settings to delete your own account

tempPassword.label: Temporary password:
tempPassword.note: Shown once. User has been disconnected and must log in again.

resetDialog.title: Reset Password
resetDialog.description: Reset the password for {{username}}? They will be disconnected immediately and must log in with the new temporary password.

demoteDialog.title: Demote Admin
demoteDialog.description: Remove admin privileges from {{username}}? They will lose access to instance settings.

deleteDialog.title: Delete User
deleteDialog.description: Permanently delete {{username}}? This will remove them from all spaces, DMs, and friends lists. This cannot be undone.
deleteDialog.password: Your password, to confirm it is you
deleteDialog.deleteSpaces: Delete these spaces with the account. Everything in them is gone for every member, and this cannot be undone.

decision.notePlaceholder: What the owner should know about this decision

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: Open requests, oldest first. Open one to read it in full, see the listing preview and its history, and decide with a reason.

spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.description: Every space this instance hosts. Open one for its reviews, badges and history.

approve.title: Verify this space?
approve.description: The space shows the verified check mark wherever it is shown, until the verification is revoked.

request_info.title: Ask for more information?
request_info.description: The request goes back to the owner with your note. It returns to the queue when they send it again.

reject.title: Reject this request?
reject.description: The space is not verified. The owner reads your reason and can send a new request.

revoke.title: Revoke the verification?
revoke.description: The check mark disappears at once. The owner reads your reason.

approve.title: List this space in Explore?
approve.description: The space appears in Explore as the preview shows it. An edit of its name, description or pictures sends it back to review.

request_changes.title: Ask for changes?
request_changes.description: The request goes back to the owner with your note. It returns to the queue when they send it again.

reject.title: Reject this listing?
reject.description: The space stays out of Explore. The owner reads your reason and can send a new request.

withdraw.title: Take this listing down?
withdraw.description: The space leaves Explore at once, or its request leaves the queue. The owner reads your reason.

badges.spaceHint: Badges you give this space. Verified is not among them: it follows the verification.
badges.userHint: Badges you give this person. Staff is not among them: it follows the administrator role.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Everything the administrators did here: suspensions, review decisions, badges, roles, invites and settings.

actions.space_delete: Deleted a space with its owner's account
actions.user_badges: Changed the badges of an account
actions.space_badges: Changed the badges of a space
actions.unknown: An action this version does not know
actions.signup_challenge_update: Changed the check against automatic sign-ups

suspension.title: Suspension
suspension.activeUntilLifted: Suspended since {{date}}, until an administrator lifts it.
suspension.hint: A suspension keeps the person out: no sign-in, no messages, no calls. Nothing of the account is deleted, and it ends by itself at the end you choose.
suspension.reasonPlaceholder: What the person did, in a sentence they will understand
suspension.reasonShown: The person reads this reason when they try to sign in.
suspension.deleted: A deleted account cannot be suspended.
suspension.self: You cannot suspend your own account.
suspension.adminFirst: Remove the administrator role before suspending this account.
suspension.confirmDescription: @{{username}} is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in. Duration: {{duration}}.
suspension.liftDescription: @{{username}} can sign in again at once.
suspension.liftNoteLabel: Reason (optional, kept in the audit log)

vanity.title: Own invite address
vanity.hint: Taking it away tells the owner why, and nobody can take that address again. The other links go on working.
vanity.confirmBody: The owner reads the reason you give here.

email.title: Email
email.intro: Mail this server sends about accounts. "Accepted" means the provider took it, not that it arrived.

off.title: Email is off
off.body: This server sends no mail, so accounts have no address and a forgotten password can only be reset by an administrator. Set EMAIL_TRANSPORT in .env to switch it on: docs/systems/email.md says how.

warnings.title: Needs attention
warnings.blocked: The provider refuses this server, because of the key or the domain. Mail is waiting, and "forgot password" says it is unavailable.
warnings.held: The day's or the month's limit is reached. Mail waits until it starts over.
warnings.heldUntil: A limit of the provider is reached. Mail waits until {{date}}.
warnings.day: Over 80% of today's limit is used. Password resets go on to the last mail; other mail stops earlier.
warnings.month: Over 90% of this month's limit is used.
warnings.bounces: Over 4% of the last 30 days' mail bounced. A provider may pause the whole account at this rate, password resets included.
warnings.complaints: Over 0.08% of the last 30 days' mail was reported as spam. A provider may pause the whole account at this rate, password resets included.
warnings.noWebhook: RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET is not set, so this server does not hear about bounces and keeps sending to addresses that fail.

required.title: New accounts
required.label: Require a confirmed address
required.description: From now on, a new account has to give an address. Until it is confirmed, the account can read the spaces it joined and talk to friends, but cannot write or react in spaces, create spaces or approach strangers. Existing accounts are not concerned.

throwaway.label: Refuse throwaway addresses
throwaway.description: Addresses at about 10,000 known throwaway mail services, such as Mailinator, can neither be used to sign up nor be set as an address. Addresses already on accounts stay.

test.title: Test
test.description: Sends one mail to check that this works. On a provider's free plan it counts against the limit.
test.queued: Test mail is on its way

delta.same: The same as the 7 days before

announcements.description: A message to everyone signed in, on a banner above the app. It goes out at once, and anyone can put it away on their device.
announcements.placeholder: Maintenance tonight at 22:00, about ten minutes.
announcements.onStatusPage: Also on the public status page

signup.description: Who cannot sign up here. This is checked when an account is made and when an address is set. Accounts that already exist keep their name and address.
signup.challengeHint: Before an account is created, the browser solves a small task. It stops simple scripts, nothing leaves this server, and people notice little of it. The lists below and confirmed addresses are for anyone who pays the price anyway.
signup.domainsHint: Addresses at this domain and everything under it are refused.
signup.usernamesHint: Nobody can sign up with these names, in any spelling of upper and lower case.
signup.addUsual: Add the usual names (admin, support, staff…)

starter.description: Public spaces every new account of this server starts in, so that nobody’s first look is an empty app. It goes for accounts made from now on and moves nobody who is already here.
starter.emptyBody: New accounts start with no spaces.
starter.noResults: No public space by that name.
starter.notPublic: No longer public: new accounts skip it until it is again.

system.description: How the server itself is doing, and a backup when you want one before a big change.
system.backupsEvery: One is taken by itself every {{interval}}.
system.restoreHint: Restoring one is done on the server, with restore.sh.

alerts.title: Problems
alerts.disk_high: The disk is {{detail}}% full. When it is full, uploads stop and the database can be damaged.
alerts.backup_old: The newest backup is {{detail}} hours old.
alerts.offsite_failed: The copy to another machine failed: {{detail}}
alerts.restart_loop: The server has started {{detail}} times within a quarter of an hour. Look at its log.

storage.title: Files
storage.hint: 0 means no limit. What the account already keeps stays when you lower it.

account.sessions: Where this account is signed in
account.endAllBody: Every device has to sign in again. The person sees this in their security activity. To keep them out, suspend the account.
account.notePlaceholder: What the other administrators should know.
account.notesHint: Only administrators see these here, and the person can read them in their data export.
account.warningHint: A notice from the operator with your reason and the way to object. It changes nothing about the account.
account.warnBody: The person sees it in the app with your reason.

bots.title: Bots
bots.switchDescription: Off by default. Turned off, every bot stops at once, and none can be made.
bots.removeBody: {{name}} leaves every space and its token stops working. What it wrote stays.
